title: Normalized ringed direct image has invertible regular-unit mate on final sites
statement: Let v:C→D be a continuous final functor of sites small relative to the module universe, R and S commutative ring sheaves and c:R→v_*S a ring-sheaf map. Let L be any specified left adjoint of the scalar-restricted sheaf-module direct image P. If P carries a lax monoidal structure normalized on local pure tensors as in [lem-pd-ringed-direct-image-pairing-lax], the regular-unit map of its left-adjoint oplax mate is invertible. No condition on the tensor components or on c being invertible is imposed.

proof.text: Uniqueness in the normalized direct-image theorem identifies the chosen lax structure with its constructed one. Its regular-unit equation therefore gives epsilon=unitToPushforwardObjUnit c, checked componentwise.

The oplax unit is the adjunct of epsilon. Compare the specified adjunction with Mathlib’s pullbackPushforwardAdjunction by leftAdjointUniq. Its unit equation and the canonical pullbackObjUnitToUnit homEquiv equation identify this adjunct with the component of the uniqueness isomorphism followed by pullbackObjUnitToUnit c. Finality makes the latter an isomorphism by Mathlib; the composite is invertible. This includes zero rings and empty sites admitting the stated hypotheses.
